mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dispute WHERE order_id=#{orderId})
SELECT id,order_id,applicant_id,respondent_id,reason_type,statement,evidence evidence_json,status,handler_id,handle_note,handled_at,created_at,updated_at FROM dispute WHERE id=#{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT d.id,d.order_id,d.applicant_id,d.respondent_id,d.reason_type,d.statement,d.evidence evidence_json,d.status,d.handler_id,d.handle_note,d.handled_at,d.created_at,d.updated_at FROM dispute d d.status=#{status} ORDER BY d.created_at DESC,d.id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dispute WHERE status=#{status}
mapper.update: UPDATE dispute SET status=#{targetStatus},handler_id=#{handlerId},handle_note=#{note},handled_at=CASE WHEN #{targetStatus}=1 THEN NULL ELSE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP END WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN(0,1)
